items.defectStatement: The align-items mixin omits -moz-box-align, although flexbox() emits display: -moz-box. Older Firefox using that fallback therefore does not vertically center children when align-items(center) is included.
obligations: Emit -moz-box-align with the supplied alignment value.
Preserve the existing alignment declarations for other flex implementations.
items.notes: The closing brace is outside the replacement range and must not be included.

items.defectStatement: Making .small-action a flex container leaves its .small-action-desc child content-sized. The edit/delete buttons are nested inside that description, so their right floats align to the short description box instead of the row's right edge.
obligations: Make the description occupy the available row width so its floated buttons align at the right.
Preserve the avatar column and vertically centered flex layout.
Keep edit/delete buttons floated within the description.
items.notes: The template confirms buttons are inside .small-action-desc, contradicting the finding's direct-child claim. That markup is absent from the frozen input. Adding margin-left:auto to the buttons alone does not fix this defect.

items.defectStatement: The description now uses 1.5% horizontal padding in a flex row, but mobile styles retain a -40px left margin on its custom message. That obsolete offset pulls the message into the action icon's column.
obligations: Neutralize the mobile custom message's negative left margin.
Preserve the new description padding and flex layout.
Preserve the custom message's vertical margins.
items.notes: A local override is possible, although removing the obsolete mobile declaration is cleaner. The override must win the cascade; an ordinary equal-specificity declaration in common styles can lose to the mobile rule.
